crossRefs.note: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”
The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
